title: Meeting Agenda
promptText:
Create a crisp 60-minute board / senior management meeting agenda for MahaTransco / transmission utility leadership.

Use these topics as inputs (expand into timed agenda items):
[Paste topics — e.g., outage performance, CapEx review, safety incidents, citizen grievances, IT security]

Agenda format:
1. Meeting objective (1 line)
2. Timed agenda table: Time | Item | Owner | Decision needed? (Y/N) | Pre-read
3. Parking lot for non-priority items
4. Decision log template (blank rows)
5. Closing: confirm owners and deadlines (last 5 minutes)

Rules:
- Assume chair is a senior officer; keep titles generic if not provided.
- Suggest realistic time boxes that sum to 60 minutes.
- Flag any topic that needs confidential papers as "Closed session — Tier 3 materials".
- Do not invent performance KPIs; use placeholders like [VERIFY KPI].
- Tone: formal, action-oriented, no motivational fluff.
